headword: {契約|けいやく}{社員|しゃいん}

definitions.explanation: An employee hired on a fixed-term contract, as opposed to a regular full-time employee (正社員). The contract is typically renewed annually or at set intervals, but the position lacks the job security and benefits of permanent employment.

examples.japanese: {契約|けいやく}{社員|しゃいん}として{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I'm working as a contract employee.

examples.japanese: {契約|けいやく}{社員|しゃいん}から{正社員|せいしゃいん}に{登用|とうよう}された。
examples.english: I was promoted from contract employee to regular employee.

examples.japanese: {契約|けいやく}{社員|しゃいん}は{正社員|せいしゃいん}と{同|おな}じ{仕事|しごと}をしていても、{給料|きゅうりょう}や{待遇|たいぐう}に{差|さ}がある{場合|ばあい}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Even when contract employees do the same work as regular employees, there are often differences in salary and benefits.

notes:
USAGE:
A key term in Japanese employment culture. Japan's labor market distinguishes sharply between {正社員|せいしゃいん} (regular, permanent employees) and various forms of non-regular employment including {契約|けいやく}{社員|しゃいん}, {派遣|はけん}{社員|しゃいん} (temporary agency workers), and パート (part-timers).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {契約|けいやく}{社員|しゃいん}として{採用|さいよう}する: to hire as a contract employee
- {契約|けいやく}{社員|しゃいん}の{更新|こうしん}: contract renewal
- {契約|けいやく}{社員|しゃいん}から{正社員|せいしゃいん}へ: from contract to regular employee

RELATED WORDS:
{正社員|せいしゃいん} (regular/permanent employee), {派遣|はけん}{社員|しゃいん} (temporary agency worker), {非正規|ひせいき}{雇用|こよう} (non-regular employment).
